description: This is a Python source file defining setup functions for an agricultural module in an ERP system, specifically creating initial item groups and analysis criteria related to agriculture, soil, water, and weather conditions. It includes references to external modules 'frappe' and 'erpnext.setup.utils'.

methods.name: setup_agriculture()
methods.description: Checks if the Agriculture Analysis Criteria are already set up; if not, initializes the data creation process.

methods.name: create_agriculture_data()
methods.description: Inserts predefined records for item groups and various agriculture, soil, water, and weather analysis criteria using the 'insert_record' utility.
